--- title: cast_dim2hier --- ## Cast Dimensional List into Hierarchical List {.unnumbered} ### Description cast_dim2hier() casts a dimensional list (i.e. an array of type list) into a hierarchical/nested list.

### Usage 
cast_dim2hier(x, ...)

## Default S3 method:
cast_dim2hier(x, in2out = TRUE, distr.names = FALSE, ...)
### Arguments
x an array of type list.
... further arguments passed to or from methods.

in2out see [broadcast_casting](aaa02_broadcast_casting.qmd).
distr.names TRUE or FALSE, indicating if dimnames from x should be distributed over the nested elements of the output.
See examples section for demonstration.
### Value A nested list.

### See Also [broadcast_casting](aaa02_broadcast_casting.qmd)
### Examples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library("broadcast") x <- array(c(as.list(1:34), as.list(letters)), 5:3) dimnames(x) <- list( letters[1:5], LETTERS[1:4], month.abb[1:3] ) print(x) ## , , Jan ##
